title: A Pathway for Assessing Grey Literature: Leveraging AI to Extract Conference Metadata and Organiser Information from Calls for Papers
abstract: arXiv:2608.24926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite its importance, grey literature, including Calls for Papers (CfPs), remains largely overlooked in Metascience and Scientometric analysis due to its unstructured, highly heterogeneous format, which traditional tools struggle to process at scale. However, Large Language Models now offer a pivotal opportunity to devise innovative tools for systematically harvesting and processing such data. In this paper, we introduce COCI, an AI-based framework that automates the extraction of granular, structured metadata from raw CfP text. COCI employs a multi-stage pipeline for entity extraction, followed by author disambiguation against OpenAlex and semantic mapping of topics and conference series. This process identifies key data points, including conference editions, geographic locations, and comprehensive lists of organisers, along with their specific roles and affiliations. translated_title: 评估灰色文献的路径：利用人工智能从征稿启事中提取会议元数据和组织者信息
translated_abstract: 尽管灰色文献（包括征稿启事，简称CfPs）具有重要意义，但由于其非结构化和高度异质的格式，传统工具难以大规模处理，因此在元科学和科学计量分析中往往被忽视。然而，大型语言模型现在提供了关键机遇，可开发创新工具来系统化地收集和处理此类数据。在本文中，我们介绍了COCI，一种基于人工智能的框架，能够从原始CfP文本中自动提取细粒度、结构化的元数据。COCI采用多阶段流水线进行实体提取，随后通过OpenAlex进行作者消歧，并对主题和会议系列进行语义映射。该过程识别关键数据点，包括会议届次、地理位置以及组织者的完整名单及其具体角色和隶属关系。通过结构化这些此前难以获取的信息，COCI为灰色文献分析开辟了新路径。
tldr: 本文提出了COCI框架，利用大型语言模型从征稿启事中自动提取结构化会议元数据和组织者信息，填补了灰色文献在元科学研究中的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces COCI, an AI-based framework that leverages large language models to automatically extract structured conference metadata and organiser information from Calls for Papers, addressing the gap of grey literature in metascience research.
